headline.title: 美联储重启加息并暗示年内再加息
headline.summary: 美联储自 2023 年 7 月以来首次加息，并预计年底前再加息一次，以遏制通胀。此举标志着货币政策进一步收紧，可能影响全球市场、汇率与资产价格，是本周最重要的宏观事件之一。
headline.title_en: World Economy Latest: Fed Boosts Interest Rates, Signals Another 2026 Hike
headline.summary_en: The Federal Reserve raised interest rates for the first time since July 2023 and signaled another hike before the end of the year, aiming to contain inflation. The move marks a further tightening of monetary policy and is likely to influence global markets, currency moves and asset prices.
headline.original_title: World Economy Latest: Fed Boosts Interest Rates, Signals Another 2026 Hike
headline.reason: 美联储重启加息并暗示年内再加息，是当天最具全局影响力的宏观政策转向，直接影响全球市场、汇率和理财决策，适合作为头条。
headline.reason_en: The Fed’s first rate hike since 2023 and its signal of another increase is the day’s most globally consequential macro policy shift, directly affecting markets, currencies and personal-finance decisions, making it a strong lead.
